mapper.sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_no, contract_id, contract_no, order_id, order_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, status, invoice_type, invoice_number, invoice_date, invoice_title, tax_number, invoice_image_url, invoice_attachment, invoice_amount, tax_amount, tax_rate, total_amount, payment_amount, pay_amount, payment_date, payment_method, bank_name, bank_account, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_invoice
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_invoice ( invoice_no, contract_id, contract_no, order_id, order_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, status, invoice_type, invoice_number, invoice_date, invoice_title, tax_number, invoice_image_url, invoice_attachment, invoice_amount, tax_amount, tax_rate, total_amount, payment_amount, pay_amount, payment_date, payment_method, bank_name, bank_account, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{invoiceNo}, #{contractId}, #{contractNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{status}, #{invoiceType}, #{invoiceNumber}, #{invoiceDate}, #{invoiceTitle}, #{taxNumber}, #{invoiceImageUrl}, #{invoiceAttachment}, #{invoiceAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{taxRate}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{paymentDate}, #{paymentMethod}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccount}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{auditOpinion}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_invoice SET del_flag = '2' WHERE invoice_id IN #{invoiceId}
mapper.select: SELECT detail_id, invoice_id, material_id, material_code, material_name, spec_model, unit, qty, unit_price, amount, tax_rate, tax_amount, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_invoice_detail WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY detail_id ASC
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_invoice_detail SET del_flag = '2' WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM pms_invoice WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('2', '3')
